transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I’m not sure how to say it. Some mornings I wake up thinking… it might be easier if I just didn’t wake up at all. I don’t have a plan to hurt myself, but it scared me enough to come in.
How long have you been having these thoughts about not wanting to wake up?
About a month, I think. It started after my sister died… unexpectedly.
Have you noticed any changes in your interest in activities that you normally enjoy?

Yes… I suppose so. I still go to things, like my book club, and sometimes the dance night. But I’m not really… there. It feels distant.

Even my garden, or cooking for the neighbors—things I used to enjoy—don’t seem to give me much of anything lately.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
I haven’t been trying to lose weight, but… food just doesn’t really appeal to me much. I’ll make a little toast or soup, and then by evening realize I’ve hardly eaten.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly or feeling restless lately?
I don’t think so. Maybe I’m a bit slower getting going some days, but I haven’t really noticed anything… obvious.
Do you often feel guilty or blame yourself for things?

Yes… I do. Mostly about my sister. I keep thinking back over those last weeks and telling myself I should’ve called more, listened better… done something more useful. Part of me knows I probably couldn’t have changed anything, but I still keep going over it.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or that you're looking forward to?

I still go to things sometimes… book club, the dance night. But I don’t really enjoy them the way I used to. It’s like I’m there but not quite in it.

Even the garden, or cooking something for the neighbors… it just doesn’t give me that little bit of pleasure anymore.
Have you experienced periods like this before in your life?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I’ve had low times, like anyone, but I don’t know if I’d say it was like this before.
Do you feel like these feelings of not wanting to wake up and lack of pleasure in activities are interfering with your daily life?

Yes… somewhat. I’ve had to ask another volunteer to cover part of the Juneteenth budgeting workshop because I just couldn’t keep up with the preparation like I usually would.

And I’ve been saying no to neighbors and friends more than I used to. I don’t make much of it, but… yes, it’s getting in the way.
How long have you been feeling this way, with no pleasure in activities and thoughts of not wanting to wake up, consistently?
About a month, I think. Since my sister died… unexpectedly. It’s been pretty steady since then.
Have these feelings of sadness and lack of pleasure been present every day since your sister's death?
Most days, yes… it’s been about a month now, since my sister died unexpectedly. It’s been pretty constant.
Are there any activities that you've tried recently where you felt even a small amount of pleasure?

Not really. I still make myself go to things, like book club or the dance night, but… I feel sort of separate, like I’m just sitting there behind glass.

Even my garden, or cooking for the neighbors… it doesn’t give me that little lift it used to.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt normal and enjoyed things like you used to?
No… not really normal. I’ve gone through the motions—book club, the dance night—but it feels like I’m sort of behind glass. Even the garden, or cooking for people… it doesn’t feel like it used to.
Are there any activities that you've found joy in since your sister passed away?

Not really. I still go to book club, or the dance night… but I just feel sort of removed from it. Like I’m there, but not really. Even my garden, cooking for neighbors… it doesn’t give me that little lift anymore.
Are there any activities where you feel even a small amount of pleasure?

Maybe a little, but… not really like before. I still make myself go to book club or the dance night, but I feel kind of behind glass. Even the garden, or cooking for the neighbors… it just doesn’t give me that lift anymore.
Have you felt any pleasure at all in the things you've been doing over the past month?

A little, maybe, but not much. I still make myself go to things like book club or the dance night… but it feels distant, like I’m behind glass. Even the garden and cooking for neighbors don’t really give me that lift anymore.
Have you felt any pleasure at all in the past few days?

Not much, no. I’ve still made myself go to book club and that dance night, but it’s like I’m sort of behind glass. Even puttering in the garden or cooking for the neighbors… it just doesn’t give me that little lift anymore.
Have your feelings of sadness and lack of pleasure lasted for most of the day, nearly every day, since your sister's death?
Yes… most days. It’s been about a month now, since my sister died so suddenly.
